# GraceNotes Daily

> A daily devotional companion for Christians. GraceNotes Daily combines AI-personalised grace notes, guided devotional readings, prayer journaling, answered prayer tracking, and habit streaks in one quiet, beautiful space.

GraceNotes Daily is a faith-based web application built for Christians at every stage of their walk with God. It is not a church, a denomination, or a theological authority. It is a gentle daily companion rooted in Scripture and designed to help believers show up consistently in their relationship with God.

## What GraceNotes Daily does

GraceNotes Daily helps Christians build a consistent daily spiritual practice through three core habits:

1. **Daily Grace Notes** — Each morning, users receive a short, personalised word of encouragement grounded in Scripture. The grace note is generated by AI (Claude by Anthropic) and tailored to the user's current faith phase, preferred daily rhythm, and season of life.

2. **Daily Devotionals** — A guided reading with a verse of the day, a reflection body, and a personal takeaway. Personalised by faith phase and preferred daily rhythm (morning, midday, evening, or night).

3. **Heart Notes (Journaling)** — A daily journaling prompt for honest, private reflection. Each entry receives an AI-generated response that is warm, grounded, and never preachy.

Additional features:
- **Prayer Journal** — A private space to write, track, and revisit prayers. Users can mark prayers as answered and write thanksgiving notes.
- **Habit Tracker (Daily Rhythms)** — Tracks daily completion of the three core practices and maintains a running streak with copper, silver, and gold day ratings.
- **Journey Archive** — A searchable archive of past devotionals, grace notes, prayers, and heart notes.
- **Listen** — Worship, prayer, and teaching audio curated for the user's faith journey.

## Who this is for

- Christians who want to build a consistent daily devotional habit
- People new to the Christian faith seeking a gentle, low-pressure starting point
- Believers who journal or want to start journaling their prayers
- Christians returning to faith after a period of distance
- Believers at any stage: exploring, growing, deepening, or walking a mature path

## Theology and tone

GraceNotes Daily draws from across the Christian tradition and is designed to be broadly accessible. Content references the Bible (multiple translations supported), uses language of grace, invitation, and belonging, and never shames or pressures the reader. The voice is soft, honest, and human.

GraceNotes Daily is not affiliated with any denomination. It is Christ-centred, Scripture-grounded, and open to Christians across traditions.

## Product-led growth and free access

GraceNotes Daily is free to start. New users complete a short onboarding that captures their faith phase, preferred daily rhythm (morning, midday, evening, or night), current season of life, and voice preference (gentle or grounding). This information drives the AI personalisation engine.

## Technology

- Frontend: React 19, TanStack Start v1, Tailwind CSS v4
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + RLS)
- AI: Claude (Anthropic) for grace notes and devotionals; GPT (OpenAI) for conversational heart note responses
- Hosting: Lovable + Cloudflare edge delivery
- All user content is private by design and never used for advertising or model training

## Founder

GraceNotes Daily was built by Product Queen, a Nairobi-based product builder who came back to faith and couldn't find an app that met her gently. So she built one. Learn more at product-queen.com.

## Free guides and resources

GraceNotes Daily publishes free, long-form Christian content guides that are openly accessible and indexable. These are not paywalled or gated.

- **The Effective Prayer Toolkit**: A practical guide to four prayer frameworks (ACTS, conversational prayer, praying Scripture, listening prayer), how to pray when it feels hard, and five practices to carry into the week. Grounded in biblical characters including David, Elijah, and Nehemiah. https://www.gracenotesdaily.com/free-prayer-toolkit

- **A Guide to Fasting**: A gentle introduction to Christian fasting — what it actually is, what the Bible shows us (Moses, Esther, Jesus, Daniel), the four kinds of fasting, how to prepare, how to use hunger as a prayer prompt, and how to break a fast. For beginners. https://www.gracenotesdaily.com/fasting-guide

- **7-Day Prayer Journal Starter Kit**: Seven days of guided prayer and reflection, each built around a biblical story and a reflection prompt. Day one: beginning again (Peter's restoration). Day two: honest prayer (the persistent widow). Day three: waiting (Abraham). Day four: gratitude (the ten lepers). Day five: praying for others (Job). Day six: the prayer you have not written (Bartimaeus). Day seven: looking back (the memorial stones). https://www.gracenotesdaily.com/7-day-prayer-journal
